description: Everything the window may ask the host to do: open, write to, and close one of the gateway's two sockets, read the supervisor's state, and rename its own title bar. No filesystem, no shell, no HTTP client -- the page's entire reach is the commands below. set-title is here for white labelling: the title lives in a config file the daemon reads at run time, so the window can only learn it from the page. See src/mcp_gateway/branding.md.
